# Sai Charan Kummetha

> Builder at heart. Product Manager II, AI Native Experiences at Paytm, with 5+ years spanning Product Management, Software Engineering, and Applied AI. IIT Kharagpur graduate (Architecture) and Google Foobar invitee.

Sai Charan Kummetha leads and builds — not just manages roadmaps. He ships 0→1 and growth-stage products end to end, combining strong product execution with deep technical grounding in distributed systems, LLMs, voice agents, and developer platforms.

## Identity

- Builder, product leader, and technical operator — moves between product strategy and hands-on engineering.
- Currently: Product Manager II, AI Native Experiences at Paytm (Feb 2026 — present), leading voice-driven and agentic product experiences.
- Previously: Product Manager (AI & Automation) and SDE-II / Tech Lead at Vegrow, and Software Engineer at LivSYT.
- Education: Bachelor's (Honours) in Architecture, Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kharagpur, 2016–2021, 7.6 CGPA.
- Academic/technical recognition: Google Foobar Invitee (2023, invitation-only algorithmic challenge), Rising Star — Paytm (2026), Excellence Award — Vegrow (2025).
- Long-term goal: building a technology company of his own, at the convergence of AI, consumer tech, and AEC (architecture, engineering, construction).
